persons.name: Cakrarāja
persons.evidence: cakrarāja dvijātīnām cakravarttisupaṇḍitaḥ | kena puṃsā pāṃdunā vai bhaktagrāmanivāsinā

notes: The colophon verse mentions 'mite śāke' but gives 'saṃ 805', which is in Nepāla Saṃvat. The syntax around Cakrarāja ('cakrarāja dvijātīnām cakravarttisupaṇḍitaḥ | kena puṃsā pāṃdunā vai bhaktagrāmanivāsinā') is corrupt/unclear.
